verdict.rationale: A managed analytics database could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no such feature. The AI-related evidence covers external coding agents connecting over MCP and agent infrastructure such as isolated read-only compute, data branches and query logging. These are building blocks for outside agents, not insights the product itself generates. Monitoring rules and grouped error signatures are user-defined or deterministic, not AI-generated suggestions.
